## Ref type

A ref as a load or a projection sees it: the key, the declared needs (present), and the  declared hints (optional: there when the base row or the link brought them, never hydrated,  never a reason to be unknown).

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Ref<K, Needs extends Attrs, Hints extends Attrs = Empty> = {
    readonly key: K;
} & {
    readonly [A in keyof Needs]-?: Exclude<Needs[A], undefined>;
} & {
    readonly [A in keyof Hints]?: Hints[A];
};
```
**References:** [Attrs](./hopgraph.attrs.md)
